daily.today_energy: The cosmos is giving you main character energy today, Sag. Your natural magnetism is amplified—people are drawn to your vibe. Lean into conversations and spontaneous moments. This is your day to shine without trying too hard.
daily.love: Whether you're single or coupled up, authenticity is your love language right now. If there's someone on your mind, a genuine text or moment of vulnerability could spark something real. No games needed—just be you.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. If you've been sitting on a project or proposal, the universe is nudging you to share it. Trust your instincts and don't dim your vision to fit someone else's comfort zone.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement—something that feels good, not forced. A walk, dance session, or stretching could shift your whole mood. Pay attention to what makes you feel alive and prioritize that energy.

weekly.overview: This week's got that chaotic-but-make-it-work energy, Sag. Venus is basically telling you to trust your gut on things that have been fuzzy. Some plot twists incoming, but honestly? They're the kind that hit different in a good way.
weekly.love: If you've been ghosting someone or they've been ghosting you, this week brings clarity. Your vibe is magnetic rn—people are noticing. Whether that's a situationship upgrade or just realizing you deserve better, listen to what the universe is trying to tell you.
weekly.career: Mercury's got your back with communication—speak up about ideas you've been sitting on. This isn't the week to play small. You're entering a phase where your work actually feels aligned with your purpose, so lean into that momentum and don't second-guess yourself.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for more movement and less doom-scrolling, bestie. Whether it's dancing, walking, or just touching grass, physical energy helps you process what's going on mentally. Your nervous system will thank you for the reset.
